title: Sprint mode
focus: Sessions, the review mix and the lightning round
content:
## A short session

**Sprint mode** is made for a phone and a spare few minutes. A session takes about five minutes.

A session starts with a short bite of the lesson. Then come small games and quiz questions.

## The path

The Sprint page shows a path of lessons, grouped by unit. Press **Start a session** to play the next stop. Finishing a lesson well passes the stop and opens the next one.

A session that ends under 70 percent leaves the stop open. You can play it again.

## Other ways to play

- **Review mix** draws questions from lessons you have read, weak spots first.
- **Lightning** is 60 seconds of one-tap questions.
- **Sort it** is one of the games. You tap each item into the right bucket. A wrong bucket flashes red and the item stays on top.

The page also has the daily goal ring and your day streak.

quiz.prompt: A Sprint session that ends under 70 percent leaves the stop open.
quiz.explanation: You need 70 percent or more to pass. Otherwise you can play the stop again.

quiz.prompt: In the game Sort it, what happens when you tap a wrong bucket?
options: It flashes red and the item stays
quiz.correct_answer: It flashes red and the item stays
quiz.explanation: A wrong bucket flashes red and the item stays on top of the pile. It counts as a wrong tap.
hints: You get a second try with the same item.
